backend/main.mo: Manages deployment metadata, tracks versions, and performs pre-publish validation checks for common deployment issues.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a no-op migration function returning an empty state.
feature_evidence.json: Defines feature evidence entries linking features to source files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for numerous frontend source files used across the app.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and theme variables for light and dark modes using OKLCH color values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README: Documentation explaining how to replace or upload media placeholders and how fallback behavior works.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app controlling unlock flow, intro popup, media sections, popups, and layout using MediaStoreProvider.
frontend/src/components/FlipImageCard.ts: 3D flip card component showing an image front and message back with keyboard support and image fallback handling.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Renders floating heart emoji animations positioned randomly across the screen.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the hero section with a customizable background and optional media manager button, showing styled birthday messages and animations.
frontend/src/components/ImageAdjustModal: Provides a modal for zooming, panning, and resetting image transforms before saving adjustments.
frontend/src/components/ImageMemorySecti: Renders a grid of memory images with optional uploaded overrides and transform data, each shown via FlipImageCard.
frontend/src/components/IntroPopup.tsx: Shows an animated introductory popup with a themed message and a button to close.
frontend/src/components/LockScreen.tsx: Implements a password lock screen with animated error feedback and unlock handling.
Displays a scrollable love letter popup with typing animation and a close button.
frontend/src/components/MediaManager.tsx: Manages uploading, editing, previewing, ordering, and publishing hero media, images, videos, and song with precheck support.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Provides a floating audio player that auto‑plays if possible and allows toggling play/pause for the uploaded or default song.
frontend/src/components/ProposalPopup.ts: Popup modal showing a romantic promise message with animated ring and close controls.
frontend/src/components/RosePetals.tsx: Generates animated falling rose petal emojis positioned randomly on screen.
Section with buttons that trigger opening a love letter and a proposal popup.
frontend/src/components/VideoMemorySecti: Displays a grid of memory videos with mute controls and fallback handling using stored media.
frontend/src/config/imageMemory.ts: Defines 43 image memory items with fallback paths and romantic messages.
frontend/src/config/romanticMessages.ts: Contains an editable array of romantic messages used for image memory cards.
frontend/src/config/videoMemory.ts: Defines six video memory items with fallback video paths.
frontend/src/context/MediaStoreContext.t: Context managing uploaded hero background, images, videos, song, and transforms with persistence and cleanup.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaDraft.ts: Manages media draft state including hero, images, videos, song, ordering, transforms, and drag interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaStore.ts: Provides access to the media store context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublishWithPrechec: Handles pre-publish checks, publishing media changes, error diagnostics, and deployment recording.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionGate.ts: Controls a simple password-based session unlock using sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingText.ts: Implements a typing animation hook that reveals text over time.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, color variables, romantic animations, and UI component styles.
frontend/src/lib/deployDiagnostics.ts: Normalizes errors into diagnostic payloads and formats them for console or user display.
frontend/src/lib/localMediaStore.ts: Implements IndexedDB storage for hero, images, videos, and song media blobs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, shadows, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the IC dapp scaffold, architecture notes, existing features, and known issues for the Motoko backend and React/Tailwind frontend.
